There is not लुक् elision of the case-affix after an अव्ययीभाव compound that ends in आ ; आम् is the substitute of its case-affix es, but not when it is the 5th case-affix.

Terms: विभक्ति-elision

The affix टच् comes after the word नौ when at the end of a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound).

Terms: टच्

In a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on such मुख 'mouth' denoting a real mouth when it comes after an indeclinable and a name of a direction or after 1. गो 2. महत् 3. स्थूल 4. मुष्टि 5. पृथु and 6. वत्स।

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term
